title: mlflow server basic-auth startup: validate MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY in the parent process before any worker spawns
answers: mlflow server --app-name basic-auth keeps restarting workers and never exits with an error; what's wrong?
Where is the basic-auth CSRF secret key checked when the server starts?
How do I add another required basic-auth setting so the server fails once instead of crash-looping?
Why does create_app still raise when the app is run under waitress or gunicorn without the secret key?
body:
Path: `mlflow server` CLI startup for the basic-auth app (`mlflow/server/__init__.py:_bootstrap_basic_auth`, called from `_run_server` before uvicorn workers are spawned) and the per-worker Flask factory `mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:create_app`, which also runs for waitress, gunicorn, tests and embedding.
Rule: the required secret key check lives in `mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:get_flask_server_secret_key`; `_bootstrap_basic_auth` calls it first, then `bootstrap_admin_user`, so a misconfigured server fails in the parent process before any worker is spawned. `create_app` calls the same helper for `app.secret_key`, so the factory stays safe outside the CLI. For a new required basic-auth setting, add a similar validator and call it from the same pre-flight, keeping the cheap checks before the admin bootstrap.
Symptom: `mlflow server --app-name basic-auth` without `MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY` raised `MlflowException` inside `create_app` in every worker; the uvicorn supervisor restarted each crashed worker indefinitely, so the command never exited and the real error was buried under repeated tracebacks.
Constraints: applies to the `basic-auth` app only; the default app skips `bootstrap_admin_user` and does not need the key. The pre-flight tests in `tests/server/test_init.py` must set `MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY` to exercise the admin bootstrap path. The `mlflow.server.auth` import requires the optional `auth` extra, so it is imported inside the function.
applies: Startup of `mlflow server` with `--app-name basic-auth`, and any change to basic-auth configuration validation or `create_app`.
says: The authentication server crash loops indefinitely instead of exiting with a clear configuration error.
Starting the tracking service with user login enabled keeps restarting without showing why.
The secure server fails to start and buries the missing secret key error in logs.
Validate server security settings immediately so startup aborts cleanly when configuration is missing.
search: During mlflow server startup with --app-name basic-auth, _bootstrap_basic_auth must validate MLFLOW_FLASK_SERVER_SECRET_KEY via get_flask_server_secret_key in the parent process before any uvicorn worker spawns. This pre-flight validation prevents infinite worker crash loops where missing secret keys cause repeated worker restarts that bury errors under supervisor tracebacks. The secret key check is also called within create_app for standalone WSGI servers like waitress or gunicorn, applying exclusively to basic-auth server deployments.
